dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a moderately concave spline curvature from the posterior insertion point to the apex, typical of a falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse morphological radius, showing no acute terminal points.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin rises at approximately a 55-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin base width is roughly 1.1 times the vertical height from the dorsal midline.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex melon arc with a consistent radius that tapers smoothly into the anterior rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby rostrum with high thickness-to-length ratio, extending minimally from the melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse inflection point where the downward slope of the melon meets the dorsal surface of the beak.
